paper_title: Paper Copilot A Self-Evolving and Efficient LLM System for Personalized   Academic Assistance
caption: Efficient deployment methods dramatically reduce the time cost. The average total time cost before efficient deployment is 87.1s (26.2s + 60.9s), which is reduced by 69.92% after efficient deployment.
model_annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of time costs associated with deployment methods, showing two categories of time costs. The chart consists of two slices, with the larger slice labeled "Reduction" in orange, occupying approximately 69.92% of the chart, and the smaller slice labeled "Efficient deployment" in blue, occupying around 30.08%. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and no legend is present. The segments appear ordered with the larger slice on the bottom and the smaller slice on top.
